target: a value-taking flag with nothing after it: shift 2 fails with one arg left, the while loop never advances, and the hook spins forever. A hook that hangs is worse than one that fails — it blocks the session that called it
cmd: AGENTIC_OBSERVE=1 bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" diff-size --base >/dev/null 2>&1 & P=$!; sleep 3; if kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null; then kill -9 $P 2>/dev/null; echo HUNG; else wait $P; echo "EXITED:$?"; fi
